app.title: Sign-in Sheet Generator
app.exitTip: Stop the program (this page will stop working once the service exits)
s1.title: ① Input Roster and Template
s1.hint: Provide the personnel roster on the left (optional), and choose a sign-in sheet template on the right (upload / built-in / my templates). Click "Next" when both are ready.
s1.tplNamePh: Template name, e.g. Training Sign-in Sheet
s1.sheetsTitle: Worksheets (tick the sheets that contain people)
lib.empty: Your template library is empty. After uploading a template, tick "Save to My Templates" to reuse it later.
err.needTpl: Please choose a sign-in sheet template on the right first (12 built-in designs, click a card to select)
err.needSheet: Please upload a roster and tick the worksheets to include (only the ones you need, e.g. staff, contractors)
tpl.failConn: Cannot reach the local service — the program may have exited. Please relaunch the Sign-in Sheet Generator and refresh this page.
toast.rosterOk: Roster loaded: {n} worksheets in total, "{name}" selected automatically. Tick more sheets below if needed (e.g. contractors)
ana.title: Template Analysis
ana.label: Template title
ana.noTitle: (not detected, files will be named "Sign-in Sheet")
ana.recogVal: {cols} mappable columns ({names} name columns, {others} others) · {fields} info fields ({blank} blank-detected)
s2.title: ② Duplicate Check
s2.hint: Criteria: name + group + ID number + phone (compared on whatever columns exist) must ALL match to count as a duplicate. The first entry of each group is kept by default; you can re-judge each one.
s2.none: No duplicates found. You can continue to the next step.
toast.marked: {n} entries marked for removal, {t} people remain
s3.title: ③ Roster Field Roles
s3.hint: Assign a role to each roster column: Auto-fill (written into sheets per person), Group by (split into multiple sheets by its values, optional), Exclude by (rows whose value matches are excluded), or Unused.
s3.mergeTitle: Group merge rules (optional, applied to "Group by" values)
s3.exclPh: Rows with this value are excluded, e.g. seconded
err.needFill: These worksheets have no "Auto-fill" column (set at least the name column to auto-fill): {labels}
s4.title: ④ Field Mapping
s4.hint: Upper part: map roster fields to template data columns (filled per person); lower part: choose the source of each template info field.
s4.noCols: No mappable data columns were detected in this template.
s4.autoFill: Filled automatically with different people — no mapping needed
s4.noFields:
No info fields were detected in this template. Only the personnel list will be filled.
If the template has fields to fill in, make sure they use the "label cell + empty cell" style, or check in step ⑤.
s5.title: ⑤ Sign-in Details
s5.hint: Fields below come from "User input" sources; anything left blank stays empty on the sheet.
ph.name: Name
s5.capHint: (template maximum is {m}; overflow automatically splits into multiple sheets, details appear on every sheet)
s6.title: ⑥ Preview
s6.summary: Generated {n} sign-in sheets covering {t} entries. Please check each one before output.
s7.title: ⑦ Output
s7.summary: {g} groups, {n} sign-in sheets, {t} entries in total. Files are in Word format.
s8.title: ⑧ Output by Group
s8.hint: Sheets grouped by the "Group by" column chosen in step ③. Each group can be downloaded separately.
redo.title: Start Over
redo.q: Do you want to change the roster and template?
redo.new: Upload a new roster and template (fresh round)
redo.keep: Keep the previous roster and template (back to step ①)
toast.done: All done. Click "Start over" for a new round.
confirm.cancel: Cancel this round? All entered details will be cleared.
err.conn: Cannot reach the local service — the program may have exited. Please relaunch the Sign-in Sheet Generator and try again.
err.oldFormat: Legacy .doc/.xls format is not supported. Please save as .docx/.xlsx with Office/WPS first
err.unsupportedFmt: Unsupported file format: {ext} (.xlsx and .docx are supported)
err.tplOldFormat: Legacy .doc/.xls is not supported. Please save as .docx/.xlsx first
err.rosterEmpty: Roster is empty: check the column mapping or duplicate settings
err.noGroupOutputs: No generated files in this group
err.tplLocate: Failed to locate the template table
err.noNameHeader: No sign-in table structure with a "Name" header row found in the template
err.noNameHeaderXls: No header row containing "Name" found in the Excel template
